17183-atma-a-romance.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. and hope to bear Immortal fruitage of sweet charity; For I believe that every piety, And every thirst for truth is gift divine, The gifts of God are not to me unclean Though strangely honoured at an unknown shrine.

arxiv-2109-15022.title: On the origin of the holographic universe
arxiv-2109-15022.creator: Haidar Sheikhahmadi
arxiv-2109-15022.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Haidar Sheikhahmadi. In this work, we reexamine the holographic dark energy concept proposed already for cosmological applications. By considering, more precisely, the bounds on the entropy arising from lattice field theory on one side and Bekenstein-Hawking entropy of black holes on another side, it is shown that the so-called holographic dark energy cannot be mimicked as easily as claimed in the literature. In addition, the limits on the electron ( g − 2 ) (g-2) experiments are taken into account again.

arxiv-2110-01054.title: A non-absorbing SIR stochastic lattice gas model on hybrid lattices Journal: Physics Letters A
arxiv-2110-01054.creator: Carlos Handrey Araujo Ferraz
arxiv-2110-01054.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Carlos Handrey Araujo Ferraz. In this paper, we perform Monte Carlo calculations to study the critical behavior of the spread of infectious diseases through a novel approach to the SIR epidemiological model. A stochastic lattice gas version of the model was applied on hybrid lattices which, in turn, are generated from typical square lattices when inserting a connection probability p p that a given lattice site has both first- and second-nearest neighbor interactions.

arxiv-2205-03149.title: Conductivity, diffusivity, and violation of Wiedemann-Franz Law in a hadron resonance gas with van der Waals interactions
arxiv-2205-03149.creator: Kshitish Kumar Pradhan, Dushmanta Sahu, Ronald Scaria, Raghunath Sahoo
arxiv-2205-03149.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kshitish Kumar Pradhan, Dushmanta Sahu, Ronald Scaria, Raghunath Sahoo. In this work, a hadron resonance gas under van der Waals (VDW) interactions has been studied. Both attractive and repulsive interactions between the meson-meson and (anti)baryon-(anti)baryon have been taken into consideration. Various transport properties such as electrical conductivity ( σ el \sigma_{\rm el} ) and thermal conductivity ( κ th \kappa_{\rm th} ) have been estimated by solving the Boltzmann transport equation under the relaxation time approximation.

arxiv-2206-04752.title: Log-concavity of the restricted partition function p 𝒜 ​ ( n , k ) p_{\mathcal{A}}(n,k) and the new Bessenrodt-Ono type inequality
arxiv-2206-04752.creator: Krystian Gajdzica
arxiv-2206-04752.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Krystian Gajdzica. Let 𝒜 = ( a i ) i = 1 ∞ \mathcal{A}=(a_{i})_{i=1}^{\infty} be a non-decreasing sequence of positive integers and let k ∈ ℕ + k\in\mathbb{N}_{+} be fixed. The function p 𝒜 ​ ( n , k ) p_{\mathcal{A}}(n,k) counts the number of partitions of n n with parts in the multiset { a 1 , a 2 , … , a k } \{a_{1},a_{2},\ldots,a_{k}\} .

arxiv-2209-14934.title: Towards a sharp, structure preserving two-velocity model for two-phase flow: transport of mass and momentum
arxiv-2209-14934.creator: Ronald A. Remmerswaal, Arthur E.P. Veldman
arxiv-2209-14934.description: Abstract The numerical modelling of convection dominated high density ratio two-phase flow poses several challenges, amongst which is resolving the relatively thin shear layer at the interface. To this end we propose a sharp discretisation of the two-velocity model of the two-phase Navier–Stokes equations.

arxiv-2301-10607.title: The quark propagator and quark-gluon vertex from lattice QCD at finite temperature
arxiv-2301-10607.creator: Orlando Oliveira
arxiv-2301-10607.description: Abstract The quark-gluon vertex is an important object of QCD. Studies have shown that this quantity is relevant for the dynamical chiral symmetry breaking pattern in the vacuum. The goal of our project is to obtain the quark-gluon vertex at finite temperature around the deconfinement/chiral transition using the tools provided by lattice QCD.

arxiv-2401-01372.title: Hopf algebras for the shuffle algebra and fractions from multiple zeta values
arxiv-2401-01372.creator: Li Guo, Wenchuan Hu, Hongyu Xiang, Bin Zhang
arxiv-2401-01372.description: Abstract . The algebra of multiple zeta values (MZVs) is encoded as a stuffle (quasi-shuffle) algebra and a shuffle algebra. The MZV stuffle algebra has a natural Hopf algebra structure which has important applications to MZVs. This paper equips a Hopf algebra structure to the MZV shuffle algebra.

arxiv-2504-06203.title: Factorizing Defects from Generalized Pinning Fields
arxiv-2504-06203.creator: Fedor K. Popov 1 and Yifan Wang 2
arxiv-2504-06203.description: Abstract We introduce generalized pinning fields in conformal field theory that model a large class of critical impurities at large distance, enriching the familiar universality classes. We provide a rigorous definition of such defects as certain unbounded operators on the Hilbert space and prove that when inserted on codimension-one surfaces they factorize the spacetime into two halves.

arxiv-2511-17276.title: Leveraging CVAE for Joint Configuration Estimation of Multifingered Grippers from Point Cloud Data
arxiv-2511-17276.creator: Julien Mérand, Boris Meden, Mathieu Grossard
arxiv-2511-17276.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Julien Mérand, Boris Meden, Mathieu Grossard. This paper presents an efficient approach for determining the joint configuration of a multifingered gripper solely from the point cloud data of its poly-articulated chain, as generated by visual sensors, simulations or even generative neural networks.

arxiv-2512-20512.title: Macroscopically distinguishable superposition in infinitely many degrees of freedom
arxiv-2512-20512.creator: Jonas Fransson, Barry C. Sanders, Artur P. Sowa
arxiv-2512-20512.description: Abstract Abstract: We investigate the concept of macroscopically distinguishable superpositions within an infinite array of boson sites. Our approach is rigorous within the frame of Hilbert space theory. In this context, it is natural to differentiate between states—and corresponding dynamics—that involve only finitely many degrees of freedom, referred to as local, and those that are inherently nonlocal.

pmc-10653321.title: Assessment of glyphosate and its metabolites’ residue concentrations in cultured African Catfish offered for sale in selected markets in Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria
pmc-10653321.creator: Selim Adewale Alarape, Adekemi Florence Fagbohun, Oladeni Adegoke Ipadeola, Anthony Ayodeji Adeigbo, Ridwan Olamilekan Adesola, Olanike Kudirat Adeyemo
pmc-10653321.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Introduction: Glyphosate is a non-targeted organophosphate insecticide whose solubility and mobility in hydrophilic solvents enable its rapid leaching into the soil and subsequent contamination of ground and surface water and possible build-up in the aquatic food chain. Based on the public health importance of glyphosate in fish through consumption, it is crucial to determine the current residue concentration in culture Clarias gariepinus species.

pmc-10899318.title: Premature Infant Gut Microbiome relationships with childhood behavioral scales: preliminary insights
pmc-10899318.creator: Samia Valeria Ozorio Dutra, Anujit Sarkar, Ji Youn Yoo, Emily Shaffer-Hudkins, Maureen Groer
pmc-10899318.description: IntroductionVery Low Birth Weight (VLBW) infants, born weighing less than 1,500 grams, are at risk for both gut dysbiosis and later neuropsychological developmental deficits. Behavioral effects, while related to neurodevelopment, are often more subtle and difficult to measure. The extent of later neurobehavioral consequences associated with such microbial dysbiosis has yet to be determined.

pmc-12464554.title: Next-generation cancer vaccines: targeting cryptic and non-canonical antigens for precision immunotherapy
pmc-12464554.creator: Anu Shibi Anilkumar, Sheena Mariam Thomas, Ramakrishnan Veerabathiran, Panagiotis J Vlachostergios
pmc-12464554.description: Cancer immunotherapy has revolutionized oncology by harnessing the immune system to target tumor cells. Cancer vaccines that trigger immune responses specific to tumors are becoming more and more popular among new approaches. Nevertheless, traditional tumour-associated antigens are susceptible to immune tolerance and frequently show low immunogenicity.

pmc-12587514.title: Innovative stimulated muscle contraction signals based digital muscle marker: a reliable tool for assessing muscle in persons with stroke
pmc-12587514.creator: Mi-Jeong Yoon, Kwangsub Song, Yerim Ji, Sangui Choi, Hooman Lee, Ji Yoon Jung, Seungyup Song, Jae Yi Kim, Miji Kim, Chang Won Won, Ilsoo Kim, Sun Im
pmc-12587514.description: BackgroundStroke leads to motor dysfunction as a result of damage to the central nervous system, often resulting in secondary muscle changes from disuse and immobilization. Existing tools for assessing these muscle changes in persons with stroke are limited, as these methods rely on voluntary muscle contractions, which are frequently impaired in hemiparesis.

pmc-12622503.title: Establishing Covalent Organic Framework “A&B” Gel via Hydrogen Bond Exchange‐Induced Microphase Separation
pmc-12622503.creator: Zhiwen Fan, Zihao Liao, Feng Zhang, Yang Huang, Chunyue Pan, Shuai Gu, Juntao Tang, Baosheng Wei, Jiayin Yuan, Guipeng Yu
pmc-12622503.description: Rapid and controllable gelation of covalent organic framework (COF) materials with ordered accessible nanochannels is conducive to their use in versatile applications. However, challenges arise from intricate high‐rate polymerization processes and unregulated phase separation, which complicate the fine management on equilibrium morphology and crystallinity in COFs.

pmc-12976639.title: Comparing the efficacy of cipaglucosidase alfa plus miglustat with alglucosidase alfa for late-onset Pompe disease: an expanded network meta-analysis utilizing patient-level and aggregate data
pmc-12976639.creator: Shuai Fu, Noemi Hummel, Simon Shohet, Neil Johnson, Alasdair MacCulloch, Jeff Castelli, William Kerr, Brian Fox, Vera Gielen
pmc-12976639.description: Aim:Treatment options for late-onset Pompe disease (LOPD) include enzyme replacement therapy (ERT) with alglucosidase alfa (alg), cipaglucosidase alfa plus miglustat (cipa + mig) and avalglucosidase alfa. However, only one randomized controlled trial (RCT) directly compared cipa + mig and alg and had relatively few ERT-naive patients.

pmc-13092046.title: Effects of mixed reality-based instruction on visual attention and stroke performance in novice badminton players
pmc-13092046.creator: Tsai-Chiao Wang, Tzu-Yi Liu, Chien-Yu Pan, Yu-Ting Tseng, Ta-Wei Tang, Chia-Liang Tsai
pmc-13092046.description: ObjectiveThis study examined the effects of a mixed reality (MR)-based auxiliary training system on visual–motor skill acquisition, with a focus on hitting accuracy and oculomotor performance in novice badminton players.MethodsForty-seven college students without prior badminton experience were randomly assigned to either a Mixed Reality Training (MRT) group or a coach-led Traditional Teaching (TT) group.

pmc-13148378.title: Salivary volatilome profiling in pediatric eosinophilic esophagitis: a pilot study on a non-invasive approach in clinical practice
pmc-13148378.creator: Rosamaria Capuano, Carla Petrella, Christian Barbato, Giulia D’Arcangelo, Giusy Russo, Alexandro Catini, Antonio Minni, Corrado Di Natale, Salvatore Oliva
pmc-13148378.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE) is a chronic immune disease requiring repeated endoscopies for diagnosis and monitoring in children. Saliva represents a promising non-invasive biofluid, and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) may indicate disease presence and activity. This study aimed to examine the VOCs profile in saliva samples from children with EoE and to compare it with other gastrointestinal (GI) conditions and healthy controls.

pmc-13232477.title: Primary Cilium Forces Neuroendocrine Shift in Prostate Cancer through YAP1 Repression and Reduced Mitochondrial Activity
pmc-13232477.creator: Yingbo Guo, Siyong Peng, Thibaud Jamet, Virginie Firlej, Marie Irondelle, Constance Nau, Christophe A. Girard, Kaushal Asrani, Tamara L. Lotan, Romain Huc, Pascale Soyeux, Matthieu Rouleau, Sandra Lacas-Gervais, Amandine Rovini, Samantha Luciano, Olivier Humbert, Renaud Schiappa, Marc Pujalte-Martin
pmc-13232477.description: Primary cilia are increasingly recognized as regulators of cellular signaling and plasticity. Here, we examined their distribution and potential relevance in neuroendocrine (NE) prostate cancer. While typically absent in localized hormone-sensitive prostate tumor cells, we detected primary cilia in neuroendocrine-like cells both in vitro and in castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) samples.

pmc-13358539.title: Explainable machine learning based on habitat analysis of axillary lymph node ultrasound images for preoperatively noninvasive evaluation of axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer: a bi-center study
pmc-13358539.creator: Mi Zhou, Yu-Long Tang, Yu-Yuan Chen, Fu-Li Chen, Qiaoxin Zhong, Shu-Ting Nie, Aijiao Yi, Bin Wang

pmc-13679771.title: Bias and precision in true‐score estimation
pmc-13679771.creator: L Andries van der Ark, Wilco H M Emons, Jules L Ellis, Klaas Sijtsma
pmc-13679771.description: We discuss two approaches to estimating the true score from classical test theory, each with a corresponding measure of uncertainty due to measurement error: the classical method with the standard error of measurement (SEM) and Kelley's method with the standard error of estimation (SEE).
